_about: RAIDEN (Nissan GT-R R35): the centre screen is a blank quad of the interior's material (its UVs collapsed onto one patch of the texture), so it gets a board laid on it, measured from its faces (rays from the driver's eye; m from the steering wheel's centre, the model's axes: x right, y up, z back): the centre screen's pages. (Its cluster is painted into the texture: left as the model has it.)
